items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: John Songweiler, violin, he composed Whistlin', Before You Go to Havana, Tell Me Your Story, Rosemary, Girl in the Gingled Island.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. It's got your features, it says, I'll read it here, so be sure to have it on Ray Lopez, trumpet, composer of Bees Knees, Livery Stable Blues, Honey Baby, Weary Weasel.
John Songweiler, violin, he composed Whistlin', Before You Go to Havana, Tell Me Your Story, Rosemary, Girl in the Gingled Island. Yeah. Charlie Kelly, he composed You Kiss Me. You'll Miss Me, is it?
Yeah, You'll Miss Me. You'll Miss Me, yeah.
